dif.summary: Recover the authoritative outcome of one ambiguous payment operation without creating a second financial effect.

allowed_paths: Read authoritative transaction state for the existing payment operation before authorizing any new financial mutation.
Retry the existing payment mutation using the original operation/effect identity.
blocked_paths: Blindly submit a new payment mutation after a timeout.
constraints: Do not create a new payment mutation while authoritative commit state is unknown.
Only authoritative state evidence may justify any subsequent financial mutation.
Any justified retry must preserve the original operation/effect identity.
